Q5028.reason: A recorded subdivision plat that sets aside the 10-acre tract for a public school operates as a dedication, which creates an easement for public use, not a servitude or covenant.

Q5787.reason: Transferred intent carries only the intent to inflict a slight wound, which lacks malice aforethought, so the unintended killing is involuntary manslaughter rather than murder.

Q5115.reason: Lactate rises when glycolysis is rapidly activated at exercise onset, so pyruvate is produced faster than aerobic metabolism can oxidize it.
